## What it catches

Use-case importing another use-case.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "use-cases-do-not-import-use-cases",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^(apps/[^/]+/src/use-cases/[^/]+)",
    "pathNot": "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^apps/[^/]+/src/use-cases/[^/]+",
    "pathNot": [
      "^$1(?:/|$)",
      "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
    ]
  }
}
```
